title: From a cutting to a plant of its own
description: Record the stages of propagation, photographs and the actions taken, keeping the link to the future card.

blocks.text: A person creates a record for a cutting and marks the changes they see with photographs. It is possible to tell apart several cuttings from the same plant, the way each is kept and the actions taken, without passing every specimen off as a grown plant.

quote.text: I wish this app had something for plants that are being propagated. I have multiple plants that are currently in water being propagated and it'll be nice if the app had something to help me keep track of the development of those cuttings

blocks.text: A separate history for the cutting

When a cutting moves on to the next stage, its history carries on in an ordinary card. The dates stay factual; a reminder suggests checking the state rather than declaring the development to have happened by the calendar.
The link to the future plant

This is a natural special mode of a collection journal. Before making a separate product, it is worth checking which fields and comparisons exactly are missing for people growing several cuttings at once.
